answer: Each agent must compose a sonnet for the vault: the beacon emits an ivory seed each epoch, and the agent must engrave a unique stanza. The first line costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent line doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at line 14 (20.4 M iterations). An ivory audit verifies each stanza against the epoch seed; any missing line voids the poem. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full vault cost because each line binds to the unique identity key—no shared verse possible.
